EXT.evidence: Initiates playful role-play as “Ben the janitor” and announces coming to the rescue; actively engages with the group and the task.

AGR.evidence: Positions self as helpful (“coming to the rescue”) and cooperates with others’ instructions during the vent-opening effort.

CON.evidence: Carefully inspects the vent, confirms the observation (“it is in fact a dark vent”), and directs others to wait, showing caution and order.

NEU.evidence: Shows no anxiety despite the dark vent and gives calm, confident directions to wait.

OPN.evidence: Engages in imaginative role-play (pretending to be a hospital worker) and explores the situation with curiosity.
